result:
I’d make a safe, loved childhood something everyone gets—not something you win by being born in the right place to the right people.

Enough food. Someone dependable. Freedom from violence. Room to be curious without being afraid.

It wouldn’t solve everything. People would still disagree, lose each other, make mistakes. But far fewer would have to spend their adult lives recovering from what happened before they had any say.
